verdict.rationale: Parahelp's guardrails let ops configure rules like transferring tickets on certain conditions (e.g., enterprise account) and gating any tool behind mandatory human Slack approval, which could be used to mark categories like refunds or transfers as human-only [parahelp-docs-6][parahelp-docs-7][parahelp-docs-31]. However, there's no explicit documentation of topic-level classification (legal threats, cancellations, security) as a distinct guardrail type or evidence that the agent is prevented from ever responding to such topics rather than just gating the final action. Missing for 10: explicit topic/category-based human-only routing (not just tool-gating), and confirmation that the agent won't draft/respond at all on these sensitive topics.
